description: Native capabilities shared by the Android WebView shell (window.AndroidInterface.invoke) and the iOS Capacitor shell (Capacitor.Plugins.BCCBNative). The web app only talks to window.BCCBNative in native-bridge.js. tools/check-native-parity.mjs fails CI when a platform is missing a method or event listed here. Implementation values: native = implemented in the platform's native bridge; firebase-messaging = provided on iOS by @capacitor-firebase/messaging through native-bridge.js; legacy-sync = provided on Android by the synchronous shared-scorecard methods listed in legacyAndroidSyncMethods.

getCapabilities.returns: { platform, appVersion, push, alarms: 'exact'|'clock'|'alarmkit'|'notification'|'none', backgroundLocation, sharedFiles }

setSession.args: { apiBase, groupId, groupName, deviceId, deviceToken, playerId }

clearSession.notes: Stops any live trip and cancels every scheduled game alarm.

scheduleGameAlarm.args: { id, gameDayId, groupId, alarmAt, leaveAt, title, body, leaveTitle, leaveBody, venueName, useClockApp }
scheduleGameAlarm.errors: invalid_time, notifications_denied (asks first when undecided), exact_alarm_denied/too_early/no_clock_app (Android). Permission failures leave any existing alarm in place.

getScheduledAlarms.returns: { alarms: [{ id, gameDayId, alarmAt, leaveAt, mode }] }

startTrip.args: { gameDayId, groupId, venueLat, venueLng, venueName, stopAfter }
startTrip.notes: Uploads send startedAt as tripStartedAt, and the web app sends it when it deletes the trip, so the Worker ignores late updates from a stopped trip. Replies that arrive after a trip stopped or was replaced are ignored.

getTripStatus.returns: { active, gameDayId, startedAt, lastUpdateAt, lastError, arrived }

consumeSharedFile.returns: { file: File | null } (iOS native returns { name, mimeType, path })

pushReceived.payload: { type, groupId, gameDayId, route, title, body }
